mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, phone_cipher, phone_hash, email, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneCipher}, #{phoneHash}, #{email}, #{role}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher}, phone_hash = #{phoneHash}, email = #{email}, role = #{role}, enabled = #{enabled}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher}, phone_hash = #{phoneHash}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
